# Color Cascade source

Original game by Boran, retrieved from GeneralBobi/color-cascade-game, branch feat/color-cascade-game, commit d96df68a2846e7648a10148e2fcf082aa99ef886 on 21 October 2026 at the owner's request.

The three frontend files are unmodified originals. The identical files in public/games/color-cascade are run directly inside an iframe by src/ui/ColorCascade.tsx. No game rules, CSS, effects, source controls, or internal wording are rewritten. The outer station observes game-over and score elements to persist the result, and supplies nickname, navigation and fullscreen. The former React adaptation was explicitly rejected and removed. A source-equality test prevents accidental changes to the shipping original.
